$note: LAYER 1. Raw values with no product meaning. Screens may NEVER reference these directly — restricted.mjs fails the build if they do — because a primitive carries no mode pairing and no accessibility contract. Semantic and pattern tokens reference them; components reference those.
$provenance: Colours: Figma (verified identical to code, see RECONCILIATION.md). Geometry, motion and type: code, because Figma's geometry is corrupted by the Figma Make paste.

900.$description: Deepest dark surface. Never pure black — the palette is plum-tinted throughout.

800.$description: Elevated dark surface: cards, sheets, tab bar.

700.$description: Dark surface nested inside an already-elevated one.

600.$description: Dark hairline: dividers, card outlines, lock-badge fill.

700.$description: Deep accent tint. Gradient starts and accent-tinted card fills.

600.$description: AA-safe CTA gradient start. Added in v1 so white body text clears 4.5:1 — see the note on lavender.500.

550.$description: AA-safe CTA gradient end. White reaches 4.77:1 here, against 2.84:1 on the original light stop.

500.$description: Brand accent. Primary for non-text use: active tab, progress fill, selected outline, focus. NOT safe behind white body text — white reaches only 4.19:1.

400.$description: Lighter accent, for accent-coloured text on dark surfaces.

300.$description: Secondary text on dark: labels, captions, supporting copy.

500.$description: Muted text on dark. FAILS AA as body text on every dark surface (2.25–2.71:1) — tracked debt.

400.$description: Muted text on light. FAILS AA (2.04–2.18:1) — tracked debt. This is one of the two tokens the old @theme block was missing.

pain.$description: Pain category. Fill/mark use only — 1.96:1 on white.

sleep.$description: Sleep category. Fill/mark use only — 1.81:1 on white.

energy.$description: Energy category. Fill/mark use only — 1.47:1 on white.

mood.$description: Mood category. Fill/mark use only — 1.58:1 on white.

meds.$description: Medication category. Fill/mark use only — 1.81:1 on white.

400.$description: Safety text on dark. AA-safe on all three dark surfaces (4.79–5.77:1). Added in v1; the original hue reached only 4.38:1 on raised.

500.$description: The safety hue. Retained for non-text safety use (icons, borders, fills) where the 3:1 threshold applies. RESERVED — never decorative.

700.$description: Safety text on light. AA-safe on both light surfaces (4.70–5.01:1); the original reached 3.54–3.78:1.

white.$description: Pure white. Only for labels on saturated fills and light cards.

black.$description: Only ever used with alpha, for scrims and shadows. Never a surface.

alpha.$note: A quantised ladder. Every translucent value in the system snaps to one of these steps, so the ~20 ad-hoc opacities found in the prototype collapse to a reviewable set. Emitters render these as the trailing byte of an 8-digit hex, which both CSS and React Native parse natively — that is why no rgba() string exists anywhere in this system.

tint13.$description: Standard tint background. The most common tint in the product.

tint20.$description: Gradient stop; inactive dot on dark.

tint27.$description: Standard tint border. 13 uses. Fails the 3:1 non-text threshold — tracked debt.

scrim72.$description: Heavy scrim; the phone-shell drop shadow.

space.$note: 8pt grid with half-steps. Unitless — emitters add px on web and leave bare numbers for React Native.

lg.$description: The default card and button radius.

full.$description: Pills and circles. Figma reports this as radii in the tens of millions — a paste artifact, not a value.

tap.$description: Minimum interactive target. WCAG / HIG floor — never go below this.

control.$description: Mode toggle and small square controls.

iconTile.$description: Category icon tile on list rows.

hairline.$description: Border width. Figma reports 1.141px throughout — a paste artifact; 1 is the authored value.

z.$note: The full elevation order, fixed. Overlays must never be authored with an ad-hoc z-index.

duration.$note: Bands from the design brief: micro 100–150, component 200–300, screen 300–350, chart draw 400–600 (first view only).

quick.$description: The de facto micro duration — 13 uses in the prototype.

theme.$description: Colour-mode change. Above the screen band by intent — a theme change is not a navigation. Named so it is an exception rather than an outlier.

draw.$description: Progress-bar fill and chart draw-in. DEVIATION: exceeds every band in the brief (see DESIGN_CRITERIA.md §7); retained for visual parity and flagged for review.

step.$description: Delay between successive items in a staggered entrance. Five steps plus a 350ms entrance keeps total choreography at 650ms, the stated ceiling.

max.$description: Maximum staggered items before the delay stops accumulating.

easing.$note: Stored as cubic-bezier control points, never as the keyword 'ease-out' — the keyword resolves to different curves in different engines, and this system targets both CSS and Reanimated.

gentle.$description: Soft settle for celebrations. The only curve permitted to overshoot, and only slightly.

bold.$description: Only weight that qualifies text for the WCAG large-text exemption.

lg.$description: Primary button label. NOTE: 16 at weight 600 is BODY text under WCAG, not large text — this is exactly how the CTA contrast failure went unnoticed.

2xl.$description: Section heading; also the large-text threshold at regular weight.

display.$description: Day-N counter and pain score. The emotional anchors.
